verdict.rationale: Martin's own docs describe a search capability that queries multiple search engines to find relevant information, so web-grounded answers are a documented first-party feature. Nothing in the evidence shows that answers include citations or links back to sources, and there is no hands-on corroboration of search quality. Missing for 10: documented citations/source attribution in answers, detail on how results are summarized or grounded, independent or hands-on corroboration of search answers.
